title: Pastoral Support Worker
description:
Are you caring, patient and passionate about helping children overcome emotional, social and behavioural challenges? Are you looking for a rewarding opportunity where you can support children's wellbeing while gaining valuable experience within education?

A specialist school in Trowbridge, Wiltshire is seeking a dedicated Pastoral Support Worker to become part of its supportive team. You will work with children aged 5-16 who may have Autism, Social, Emotional and Mental Health (SEMH) needs, as well as a range of additional learning requirements.

This position offers the chance to work within a nurturing school environment alongside experienced teachers, pastoral staff, therapists and SEN professionals.

The Role

As a Pastoral Support Worker, you will help children feel safe, valued and supported throughout their school day. You will provide emotional and practical assistance both within the classroom and during other areas of school life.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing one-to-one and small-group pastoral support.
- Helping children understand and manage their emotions.
- Encouraging positive coping techniques and emotional resilience.
- Building trusting relationships that promote confidence and self-esteem.
- Supporting children during challenging emotional or behavioural situations.
- Encouraging positive behaviour through clear, consistent and supportive guidance.
- Providing additional support during break times, lunchtimes and other less structured periods.
- Delivering appropriate pastoral activities and targeted interventions.
- Encouraging attendance, participation and engagement with learning.
- Helping children develop communication, social and independence skills.
- Working collaboratively with teachers, pastoral staff, therapists and SEN professionals.
- Contributing to a calm, safe and inclusive school environment.
- Following safeguarding procedures and maintaining professional boundaries.

About You

We are seeking someone who is patient, compassionate, resilient and approachable, with a genuine passion for helping children develop emotionally, socially and academically.

Previous experience in education, care, youth work or a similar support role would be beneficial, although graduates and candidates looking to start a career working with children may also be considered.

You should be able to remain calm and professional when faced with challenging situations and provide children with consistent boundaries, reassurance and encouragement.

This role would be particularly valuable for individuals considering careers in:
- Education and Teaching
- Youth Work
- Social Work
- Counselling
- Psychology
- Mental Health Support
- Pastoral Care
- Special Educational Needs (SEN)

Why Apply?
- £85-£110 per day, depending on experience.
- Full-time, Monday to Friday position.
- Gain hands-on experience supporting children with Autism, SEMH and additional needs.
- Work alongside experienced teachers, therapists, pastoral teams and SEN professionals.
- Develop valuable skills in emotional wellbeing, behaviour support and safeguarding.
- Gain practical experience within a specialist educational setting.
- Excellent experience for aspiring teachers, counsellors, social workers, psychologists and youth workers.
- Access to ongoing training, guidance and professional development.
- Make a genuine difference to children's confidence, wellbeing and progress.

Every child has individual strengths, needs and challenges. As a Pastoral Support Worker, you will provide the encouragement, consistency and positive support children need to overcome difficulties and make progress.

Whether you have previous experience in a support-based role or are looking to begin a career in education, psychology, social care or mental health, this Pastoral Support Worker position in Trowbridge, Wiltshire offers valuable experience alongside the opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

If you are passionate about helping children build resilience, confidence and positive relationships, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today for this Pastoral Support Worker opportunity in Trowbridge, Wiltshire, and take the next step towards a rewarding career supporting children with additional needs.

Salary will be determined by the successful candidate's qualifications and relevant experience, and will be in accordance with the client's pay policy.
